Definition: to strike with a sting (as a serpent); figuratively, to oppress with interest on a loan
BiblicalUsage: 1) to bite; 1a) (Qal) to bite; 1b) (Piel) to bite; 2) to pay, give interest, lend for interest or usury; 2a) (Qal) to give interest; 2b) (Hiphil) to make to give interest
